submission.label: Simulated on BNB mainnet
submission.note: Every deposit in this submission runs as eth_call + state override against the real IXS vaults (or on an Anvil mainnet fork). Live mode is a ready capability (opt-in per wallet, wallet-signed, exact-amount approvals, hard cap per transaction, Live minimum 104 USDC into ixv1) and was not executed in this submission.

note: At capture time no IXS vault accepted deposits: both open vaults returned maxDeposit 0 (NAV older than the contract's staleness threshold, the NAV-staleness effect IXS described on 24 Sep 2026), so SERV deferred them and nothing was built. Simulations and fork runs from when the NAV was fresh are listed below.

statements.statement: Simulated execution is accepted for the submission (mainnet preferable). No mock tokens or mock vaults.

Daily cutoff 17:00 SGT (09:00 UTC) on Singapore business days (Mon–Fri); requests can be sent anytime and are processed at the next cutoff; settlement ≈ 1 business day. Singapore public holidays: assumed, not confirmed by IXS.
A deposit limit of 0 is the NAV-staleness effect between updates, not a closed vault → treat as temporarily paused, waiting NAV refresh (DEFER, not REJECT).
Redemption has no claim step: the vault sells the underlying RWA, the operator finalizes and USDC is sent directly to the receiver.

Direct contract builds are allowed for the verified Avalanche proxy 0xaD01573b459805E3954398796203d830B57A8bD9 as a fallback when the MCP fails for a non-safety reason; never when limit / NAV checks fail.

sections.heading: Treasury condition
sections.body: Total $1,988,150; idle $1,640,900 (83%) for 23 days: 12.4 BTC + 595,270 USDC. 1 existing IXS position ($347,250). Execution mode: simulated.

sections.heading: Policy
sections.body: SERV decides; deterministic policy guardrails enforce hard limits: liquidity floor 30%, max single-asset exposure 70%, minimum vault risk score 80, minimum deposit 100 USDC per request (confirmed by IXS), Live cap 150 USDC per transaction, NAV stale after 72 h. Live redeemable minimum: ixv1 ceil(100 / 0.995 × 1.03) = 104 USDC, which keeps the whole position redeemable above the 100 USDC net minimum (minRedeemAssets) after the 0.5% redeem fee (feeBps), with a 3% NAV buffer. Live mode is opt-in (off: this run is simulated). Monthly burn $185,000. Liquidity floor: 83% liquid vs 30% floor; Asset exposure: BTC 53% vs 70% limit; Vault risk: No candidate passed pre-flight; Pre-flight (limit, NAV, minimum, eligibility): IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB: defer (limit 0, NAV 2.1 d); IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche: defer (limit 0, NAV 10.9 d); IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB · Licensed: reject (limit 0, NAV 6.9 d); IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche · Licensed: reject (limit 0, NAV 10.9 d); BTC Real Yield: reject.

sections.heading: Proposed allocation
sections.body: No allocation now. No candidate passes all pre-flight checks with a positive deposit limit, so there is nothing to allocate. The two open USDC vaults are temporarily paused at maxDeposit 0 due to stale NAV, the licensed vaults fail whitelist eligibility, and the BTC strategy is not deployed.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body: RWA credit risk: the vault holds U.S. Treasuries and high-yield corporate bonds through a licensed structure; returns depend on their performance and are not guaranteed. Redemptions are queued for the operator (request → awaiting RWA sale & operator finalization → paid, no claim step) with a 0.5% redemption fee read from feeBps(); NAV is updated periodically off-chain, so entry and exit prices can drift between updates. Smart-contract and counterparty risk apply.

sections.heading: Execution
sections.body: Simulated on mainnet: eth_call + state override against the real vault; nothing is sent. Live mode is an opt-in capability (wallet-signed, capped at 150 USDC per transaction) and is not used in this run.
